_source.what: Verbatim refusal bodies from svc-reputation in PRODUCTION. Captured with curl, not written by hand — the whole point of this file is that it is evidence of the shape the endpoint really sends, not a restatement of what this collector assumes.
_source.why: ravn-actions#11: the endpoint emits the refusal deeplink as `help`; the collector read `link ?? url`, so every refusal in prod fell back to the portal root. Both suites passed throughout, because each side tested its own invented fixture. A hand-written fixture here would reintroduce exactly that blind spot.
_source.capturedFrom: the ravn-developer devcontainer, over the public internet — no auth, no VPN
_source.howToRecapture: Re-run each entry's `request` verbatim and paste the response body into `bodyText` unchanged, then update `capturedAt`. Nothing else in this file is derived.
_source.doNotEdit: Never hand-edit `bodyText`. If a body here no longer matches what prod sends, that difference is the finding — recapture, and read the diff before changing any test.
_source.limits: Only the two unauthenticated refusal paths and one bad-signature path can be reached without a live Actions OIDC token, so codes like `no-binding`, `repo-mismatch`, `job-locked` and `job-expired` are not captured here. The prod run in ravn-actions#11 (dwelch2344/ravn-attestation-demo run 32803993877) shows `no-binding` taking the same shape. What every captured body shares — and what the collector must honour — is that the deeplink field is named `help`.
